title: Add Dashboard Sidebar

variants.advanced: Create professional dashboard sidebar. Layout: fixed or static, full height, flex column. Collapse: toggle between full (w-64) and collapsed (w-16) modes, icons only when collapsed, tooltips for labels. Logo: clickable, different versions for full/collapsed. Search: optional command palette trigger in sidebar. Navigation structure: grouped sections with headers, nested items (expandable), badges for counts/status. Nav item: icon, label, optional badge, optional submenu indicator. Item states: default, hover, active/current, disabled. Submenu: expand on click, animate height, indent children. Icons: consistent size and style, active state color. Hover: background color, scale icon slightly. Sections: collapsible groups, persist collapse state. Favorites/pinned: user-pinnable items at top. Recent: recently visited items section. Footer: user avatar/name, role, dropdown for settings/logout. Notifications: indicator on relevant items. Keyboard: arrow keys navigate, Enter selects, Escape closes submenus. Mobile: overlay drawer with backdrop, swipe to close. Responsive: auto-collapse on medium screens. Theme: support light/dark modes. Accessibility: proper navigation landmark, aria-current for active item.
